userJourneys.name: Discover an unbaselined existing system
userJourneys.trigger: Core resolves an existing-undiscovered project state with an exact repository snapshot and no architecture baseline or valid current snapshot.

steps.action: Core validates the project state, repository snapshot, policies, adapter chain, options, and grants.
steps.expectedOutcome: Discovery starts only from exact approved context and a drift-free repository state.

steps.action: The native inventory adapter inspects the allowed local repository surface and optional analyzers contribute bounded observations.
steps.expectedOutcome: Every observation retains exact method, source, confidence, and native provenance.

steps.action: Trusted validation normalizes observations, identifies gaps, and determines whether the candidate can reach the discovery Gate.
steps.expectedOutcome: Material uncertainty blocks; non-material uncertainty remains visible for explicit Gate disposition.

sourceRefs.location: All three checkpoint-bound recommended decisions approved in chat

userJourneys.name: Integrate one verified work-item change

userJourneys.outcome: The configured local target either advances atomically to an evidenced post-state or remains unchanged with an explicit conflict, drift, or failure artifact.

steps.action: Core binds the exact verification approval, verified change, target repository snapshot, target ref, expected commit, and integration policy.
steps.expectedOutcome: No caller or adapter can substitute the subject or integration target.

steps.action: Core compares the live target ref to the expected commit and invokes the configured local Git integration adapter only when they match.
steps.expectedOutcome: Concurrent work serializes and stale work cannot mutate the shared target.

steps.action: Core validates the effect receipt and either records the exact integrated post-state or returns an immutable no-mutation failure artifact.
steps.expectedOutcome: Only proven integration creates completion facts and unlocks frontier recalculation.

currentStatus.summary: V0.11 module-quality requirements are clarified and closed: adaptive breadth-first requirements interviews, live-attested priority providers, an optional Godot pack, automatic receipts, two-phase Git sealing, queryable traceability, local telemetry, and four repository-scoped Desktop skills.

sourceRefs.location: All twenty-one normalized blocking decisions approved across the preserved interview waves

content.objective: Raise every released DevRelay module toward best-in-class live integration while preserving deterministic Core authority and a production-quality ChatGPT Desktop on Windows path.

scope.boundary: DevRelay V0.11 module quality, live-provider conformance, receipts, trace queries, Desktop skills, and optional Godot engineering support.
in: adaptive breadth-first requirements strategy composition and mandatory closure
project-local checksum-pinned provider acquisition and explicit failure
live OpenSpec, Spec Kit, Structurizr, and MADR adapter evidence
local raw receipts, redacted Git views, and performance telemetry
optional Godot AI MCP and GdUnit4 pack with a tested compatibility matrix
out: silent provider installation, upgrade, fallback, or substitution
Sentry or PostHog installation or activation
provider ownership of lifecycle routing, closure, Gates, or TraceabilityGraph

content.problemSummary: The lifecycle contracts are deterministic, but requirements closure is not yet Core-enforced, several important providers are not live-attested, raw effects lack one canonical receipt boundary, trace reports are verbose, and the optional Godot path lacks structured execution and verification support.
content.solutionSummary: Add typed adaptive interviewing, host-owned provider acquisition, canonical receipts and metrics, bounded live providers, compact read-only trace queries, two-phase Git sealing, repository skills, and an optional Godot engineering pack.
behaviorFlows: Core selects typed requirements strategy roles, admits breadth-first questions, and computes closure from exact decisions.
The host acquires an explicitly approved checksum-pinned project-local provider; adapters only receive the verified binding.
Every live adapter effect emits exact native artifacts and a canonical local receipt before downstream progression.
Trace queries read one immutable graph checkpoint and return compact deterministic paths with evidence expansion.
ChangeIntegration creates the implementation commit, then a separate evidence-seal transaction binds verified receipts.
Repository skills guide ChatGPT Desktop through released operations without gaining authority.
The optional Godot pack performs separately granted MCP effects and GdUnit4 verification against a pinned compatibility matrix.
dataResponsibilities: ProviderBinding owns acquisition approval, checksum, version, location, availability, and grants.
ExecutionReceipt owns exact process/tool observations and redaction lineage.
ModuleMetricsAttachment owns host-observed metrics and unavailable dispositions.
TraceQueryResult owns checkpoint-bound compact paths and evidence refs.
EvidenceSealRecord owns implementation and sealing commit identities.
GodotCompatibilityRecord owns only live-tested version combinations.
failureHandling: Missing or drifting providers fail explicitly without silent fallback.
Unclosed decision domains or contradictions return clarification.
Missing raw evidence, secret findings, or invalid redaction blocks receipt publication.
Unsupported Godot versions or missing granular grants fail before effects.
Git conflict or self-reference retires the seal candidate.
Stale graph checkpoints fail trace queries.
securityPrivacy: Downloads and effects require exact host-enforced grants.
Raw receipts and telemetry remain local by default.
Godot input, run, write, screenshot, and test operations are separately granted and receipted.
Skills and MCP query surfaces remain non-authoritative.
performanceReliabilityOperability: Metrics expose instrumentation overhead and unavailable values.
Receipts and query outputs use canonical ordering and digests.
Provider and compatibility claims bind exact versions.
Checkpoint replay performs zero duplicate adapter effects.
compatibilityMigrationRollout: Ship the infrastructure contracts before claiming live provider maturity.
Promote each adapter only after version-pinned conformance and failure-path evidence.
Keep Godot in an optional pack so existing consumers take no domain dependency.
Validate the complete clean-checkout Desktop path before V0.11 release.
verificationIntent: Exercise adaptive interviews with small, large, ambiguous, contradictory, and resumed goals.
Test provider acquisition, checksum drift, offline reuse, absence, failure, and forbidden fallback.
Run live OpenSpec, Spec Kit, Structurizr, and MADR conformance with archived receipts.
Run Godot MCP and GdUnit4 focused/full/flake/soak/export/smoke evidence on a pinned Windows matrix.
Test trace query determinism and mutation rejection.
Prove two-phase sealing and clean ChatGPT Desktop end-to-end operation.

elements.name: Release Tooling

responsibilities: Project the declared package export contract
Materialize and verify the installable tarball
Assemble exact release evidence and promotion intent

elements.name: Package Export Projector
elements.description: Derives the complete fixed and wildcard public-subpath inventory directly from package.json exports.
responsibilities: Expand wildcard targets deterministically
Reject invalid, duplicate, escaping, or missing export targets

elements.name: Tarball Materializer
elements.description: Builds the exact installable GitHub release tarball from the approved source candidate.
responsibilities: Materialize npm-compatible tarball bytes without registry publication
Bind contents to source, metadata, and export inventory

elements.name: Installed Package Verifier
elements.description: Installs the tarball into a clean consumer and exercises every declared public subpath.
responsibilities: Resolve fixed and expanded wildcard exports
Import executable and JSON surfaces under supported Node versions

elements.name: Release Evidence Assembler
elements.description: Assembles exact catalog, checksums, test results, installed-consumer evidence, governance evidence, and dogfood receipts.
responsibilities: Reject missing, stale, unrelated, or unsupported release claims

elements.name: GitHub Promotion Adapter
elements.description: Projects an approved release candidate into GitHub source, protected-main, and release-asset operations enforced by the host.
responsibilities: Never publish to npm
Require exact acceptance and repository-setting evidence before promotion

elements.name: Adaptive Interview Orchestrator
elements.description: Orders typed explore, challenge, clarify, and validate strategies while Core owns breadth-first waves, coverage, contradiction detection, and mandatory closure.
responsibilities: Build deterministic question waves
Reject premature requirements closure

elements.name: Provider Toolchain Manager
elements.description: Resolves project-local checksum-pinned provider tools after explicit acquisition approval and never silently upgrades or substitutes them.
responsibilities: Verify provider manifests and checksums
Enforce offline and failure dispositions

elements.name: Execution Receipt Recorder
elements.description: Canonicalizes immutable local raw execution receipts and digest-bound redacted Git views for bounded provider effects.
responsibilities: Capture exact process and tool observations
Redact and validate publishable receipt views

elements.name: Local Performance Metrics Recorder
elements.description: Attaches host-observed cycle, retry, test, cache, change, receipt, token, and tool metrics to ModuleExecutionRecord without inventing unavailable values.
responsibilities: Measure lifecycle performance and overhead
Keep telemetry local and non-authoritative

elements.name: Read-only Trace Query Service
elements.description: Answers provenance, coverage, evidence, impact, and orphan questions from approved graph state using compact deterministic paths.
responsibilities: Provide compact shortest-path results
Prevent every query-side mutation

elements.name: Two-phase Evidence Seal Coordinator
elements.description: Separates the implementation commit from a later evidence-sealing commit so neither commit embeds its own identity.
responsibilities: Bind evidence to an immutable implementation commit
Produce a separate accepted seal reference

elements.name: Live Provider Adapters
elements.description: Hosts bounded live specification, architecture-modeling, and decision-recording adapters without owning workflow progression.
responsibilities: Execute exact bounded provider capabilities
Emit native artifacts and live conformance receipts

elements.name: Specification Provider Adapters
elements.description: Executes bounded OpenSpec and Spec Kit operations and evaluates BMAD, GSD, and Superpowers only as typed requirements strategies.
responsibilities: Archive exact native artifacts
Return explicit provider absence or failure

elements.name: Architecture Provider Adapters
elements.description: Runs current Structurizr validation, inspection, and export plus template-pinned MADR rendering and validation.
responsibilities: Validate and export the real C4 model
Render decision records without claiming a fictitious MADR CLI

elements.name: ChatGPT Desktop Skills
elements.description: Provides repository-scoped DevRelay operator guidance for Windows Desktop without acquiring Module, Gate, or graph authority.
responsibilities: Expose four bounded DevRelay skills
Delegate all lifecycle effects to released contracts

elements.name: Repository Skill Bridge
elements.description: Maps devrelay-cycle, devrelay-godot-release, devrelay-plugin-conformance, and devrelay-trace-query guidance to released library operations.
responsibilities: Load project-local skill instructions
Preserve explicit user approval and host boundaries

elements.name: Optional Godot Engineering Pack

Bind GdUnit4 evidence and compatibility

elements.name: Godot AI MCP Adapter

elements.name: GdUnit4 Verification Adapter

workItems.objective: Assemble exact release evidence and prove every approved public OSS criterion before BusinessAcceptance and GitHub promotion.

included: Canonical suite, package, installed consumer, Windows matrix, governance, security, Desktop dogfood, traceability, integration, system, and protected-main evidence.
Record explicit exclusions for npm, Desktop plug-in, and hosted backend.
excluded: Self-approving the release, publishing before acceptance, or weakening failed evidence.

deliverables.description: Content-addressed release evidence set and BusinessAcceptance candidate.

dependency-hints.rationale: Acceptance requires the independent Desktop lifecycle run.
Acceptance requires exact automation and catalog evidence.
Acceptance requires the final public governance surface.
Acceptance requires protected-main evidence.
Acceptance requires the release-defining compatibility matrix.

checks.method: Evaluate every approved criterion against exact evidence digests, reject stale or missing proof, and generate a bounded BusinessAcceptance request without performing promotion.
checks.successCriteria: Every approved release criterion has current evidence and no unsupported distribution or product claim remains.

required-evidence.description: Every approved release criterion has current evidence and no unsupported distribution or product claim remains.

workItems.objective: Use the installed DevRelay tarball through ChatGPT Desktop on Windows to build and verify a separate minimal software project end to end.

included: Run the full released lifecycle with real artifacts, gates, checkpoints, traceability, execution, verification, integration, system verification, and acceptance.
Capture usability friction and human-readable run evidence.
excluded: A one-click Desktop plug-in, hosted backend, or self-verification using only DevRelay's repository.

deliverables.description: Independent minimal-project lifecycle run and exact evidence bundle.

dependency-hints.rationale: The independent dogfood must use the exact verified installed tarball.

checks.method: Create a clean minimal project, invoke every applicable released module and gate, verify produced software, then replay checkpoints and inspect traceability and the lifecycle report.
checks.successCriteria: A ChatGPT Desktop Windows session can use only the installed tarball and GitHub-source docs to produce verified working software with complete evidence.

required-evidence.description: A ChatGPT Desktop Windows session can use only the installed tarball and GitHub-source docs to produce verified working software with complete evidence.

workItems.objective: Provide deterministic GitHub verification and release automation without adding npm publication.

included: Pinned verification, dependency review, CodeQL, scorecard, and GitHub-source release workflows.
Generate release catalog and checksums from exact source and package bytes.
excluded: npm publish, unpinned third-party actions, or workflow-owned business acceptance.

deliverables.description: Pinned GitHub Actions and release evidence automation.

dependency-hints.rationale: Catalog and release evidence include the final governance surface.
Release automation must require the release-defining Windows evidence.

checks.method: Validate workflow syntax, action pins, permission boundaries, event routing, catalog/checksum freshness, and absence of registry publication operations.
checks.successCriteria: GitHub automation validates and packages exact source deterministically while all release authority remains downstream of lifecycle gates.

required-evidence.description: GitHub automation validates and packages exact source deterministically while all release authority remains downstream of lifecycle gates.

workItems.objective: Complete the Apache-2.0, DCO, community, support, and security surface for the public repository.

included: License, notice, DCO, contribution, governance, conduct, support, security-contact, ownership, issue, PR, and dependency-policy files.
Use garrett.audet@gmail.com as the public security contact.
excluded: CLA enforcement, private vulnerability contents, or a hosted community portal.

deliverables.description: Complete public OSS governance and security document set.

checks.method: Validate required files, metadata, contact values, DCO instructions, links, and release-catalog inclusion against the exact candidate.
checks.successCriteria: A GitHub user can understand license, contribution, governance, support, and private vulnerability reporting without unsupported claims.

required-evidence.description: A GitHub user can understand license, contribution, governance, support, and private vulnerability reporting without unsupported claims.

workItems.objective: Make the installable tarball faithfully expose every public package subpath declared by package.json.

included: Derive fixed and wildcard export inventory from package.json.
Include the missing ArchitectureDiscovery module and plug-in resources in the package.
excluded: Publishing to npm or adding a hosted distribution service.

deliverables.description: Export-derived package inventory, corrected package metadata, and exact tarball contents.

dependency-hints.rationale: The tarball must expose the complete released WorkExecution runtime, not only its contracts.

checks.method: Pack the candidate, expand every fixed and wildcard export, install it into a clean consumer, and import or parse every public subpath.
checks.successCriteria: The exact GitHub-source tarball installs without registry publication and every declared public export resolves from installed bytes.

required-evidence.description: The exact GitHub-source tarball installs without registry publication and every declared public export resolves from installed bytes.

workItems.objective: Verify and enforce main as the protected default branch before public release promotion.

included: Query default branch, rulesets or protection, required checks, review expectations, and repository security settings.
Bind host-owned evidence to the exact promotion request.
excluded: Encoding GitHub settings as source truth or bypassing owner-only repository controls.

deliverables.description: Protected-main and repository-security evidence receipt.

dependency-hints.rationale: Protected main requires the final named checks and workflow set.

checks.method: Read GitHub repository settings, compare them to policy, apply owner-authorized settings when permitted, and capture the resulting immutable receipt.
checks.successCriteria: main is the default protected branch with the required release checks, and any owner-only gap is explicit before promotion.

required-evidence.description: main is the default protected branch with the required release checks, and any owner-only gap is explicit before promotion.

workItems.objective: Make Windows Node 22 and Node 24 the release-defining package and installed-consumer verification matrix.

included: Canonical verification, exact package inspection, isolated install, public export exercise, and deterministic negative export fixtures.
Preserve matrix results as exact release evidence.
excluded: Treating non-Windows CI as a substitute for the Windows release gate.

deliverables.description: Windows Node 22/24 package and installed-consumer verification suite.

dependency-hints.rationale: Installed verification consumes the exact corrected tarball and export inventory.

checks.method: Run canonical and clean installed-consumer gates on Windows under Node 22 and Node 24, including invalid, duplicate, missing, and escaping export fixtures.
checks.successCriteria: Every supported Windows/Node job passes against the same tarball identity and every failure mode is deterministic.

required-evidence.description: Every supported Windows/Node job passes against the same tarball identity and every failure mode is deterministic.

workItems.objective: Implement the complete provider-neutral WorkExecution Core path declared by the released module contract.

included: Validate exact baselines, readiness, assignment, binding, policy, and repository identity before executor entry.
Checkpoint exact raw executor bytes, replay with zero calls, and assemble only ExecutionAttempt, ChangeSetDraft, and ExecutionEvidenceBundle candidate outputs.
Project only trusted candidate attempt and produces relationships through the WorkExecution traceability contributor.
Export the runtime and cover drift, permission, substitution, failure, interruption, retry, traceability, and replay paths.
excluded: Selecting a specialist, scheduling work, enforcing the host sandbox, verifying a change, integrating it, or creating completion facts.

deliverables.description: Released WorkExecution input guard, frontier validator, binding validator, checkpoint controller, result assembler, traceability contributor, and orchestration API.

checks.method: Run focused positive and negative runtime tests proving exact readiness, binding, checkpoint, replay, output, retry, trusted candidate traceability, and no-downstream-authority behavior.
checks.successCriteria: A host can invoke one exact ready work item through the installed provider-neutral runtime and receive only validated candidate execution artifacts plus trusted forward candidate traceability with byte-identical zero-call replay.

required-evidence.description: A host can invoke one exact ready work item through the installed provider-neutral runtime and receive only validated candidate execution artifacts plus trusted forward candidate traceability with byte-identical zero-call replay.

deliverables.description: Adaptive interview orchestrator, closure evaluator, and regression fixtures.

required-evidence.description: A ChatGPT Desktop user can invoke all four guided workflows using released APIs while Core retains routing, validation, graph, and Gate authority.

excluded: Signing releases, pushing branches, or bypassing BusinessAcceptance authority.

required-evidence.description: The evidence seal proves exact implementation ancestry and evidence bytes without embedding either commit's identity in itself.

excluded: Exporting source, logs, or telemetry to a hosted service by default.

required-evidence.description: Every bounded effect has immutable local provenance and every redacted view is verifiably bound to retained raw bytes.
